messages.subject: Construction & Engineering Disputes - half-day update (CPD 3 hrs)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Colleague,

Join us on 26 March for our half-day update on recent TCC decisions, including developments on exclusion clauses and UCTA reasonableness. 3 CPD hours. Early-bird rate ends 28 February.

Book online at hatchwellcpd.co.uk.

Hatchwell CPD
